tools.name: find_london_district
tools.description: Resolve a place name, borough, Tube or rail station, outward code or full postcode to the London postcode district(s) the other tools take. Returns up to 15 matches with their borough(s) and how each matched. To screen districts on prices, commute, crime, schools, flood or rent, use find_london_districts instead.

query.description: A place ("Walthamstow", "Clapham"), borough ("Hackney"), station ("Clapham Junction"), outward code ("SW1") or postcode ("E17 4QH").

tools.name: find_london_districts
tools.description: Find the London postcode districts that meet several open-data criteria at once: a maximum Land Registry median house price, a maximum commute to a work hub, crime at or below the London rate or under a rate per 1,000 residents, a minimum number of Outstanding state schools, a maximum share of postcodes in flood zone 3, a maximum ONS official borough rent for a number of bedrooms, and an optional borough. Each match carries the figures that qualified it, with sample sizes, and its page URL; districts that cannot be checked for lack of data are counted, not hidden. When nothing matches, it returns the districts that miss by only one criterion, closest first, with by how much, and names the criterion that rules out most of them. Houses only: flat medians are not compared across districts (retirement flats are not identified in Land Registry data).

max_median_house_price_gbp.description: Only districts whose median sold price of existing houses (12 months) is at or under this.

hub.description: Work hub for the commute criterion or sort. canary-wharf (Canary Wharf), city-of-london (Bank / Liverpool Street / Moorgate), kings-cross (King's Cross), westminster (Westminster), oxford-circus (Oxford Circus), london-bridge (London Bridge), paddington (Paddington), stratford (Stratford), hammersmith (Hammersmith), victoria (Victoria), waterloo (Waterloo), farringdon (Farringdon).

max_commute_minutes.description: Only districts whose typical door-to-door minutes to hub are at or under this (needs hub).

crime_at_or_below_london_rate.description: Only districts whose residential crime per 1,000 residents is at or below London as a whole.

max_crimes_per_1000_residents.description: Only districts at or under this many residential-relevant crimes per 1,000 residents a year.

min_outstanding_schools.description: Only districts with at least this many state schools currently graded Outstanding by Ofsted.

max_flood_zone_3_pct.description: Only districts with at most this % of postcodes in Environment Agency Flood Zone 3.

max_official_rent_gbp_pcm.description: Only districts whose borough(s) have an ONS official average monthly rent at or under this (see bedrooms).

bedrooms.description: Bedrooms for the rent criterion: all (default), 1, 2, 3 or 4+.

borough.description: Only districts with postcodes in this London borough, e.g. "Lewisham".

sort_by.description: Order of the matches (lowest first, Outstanding schools most first). Default: the first criterion given.

tools.name: check_london_postcode
tools.description: Open-data facts at one full London postcode (e.g. "E17 4QH"): the Environment Agency flood zone at its centre; whether its centre is inside a conservation area, listed building outline, Article 4 direction area or tree preservation order area (planning.data.gov.uk, with "unknown" where the borough publishes no data); its Census neighbourhood's police.uk crime rate per 1,000 residents against London, Index of Multiple Deprivation decile and housing tenure; the nearest state schools with their own Ofsted grade and the nearest stations, by straight-line distance; door-to-door commute minutes from its postcode sector to 12 work hubs; council tax bands for its borough; and its district page. Every block says which area it describes; a single home can differ.

postcode.description: A full London postcode, e.g. "E17 4QH" or "sw112ar".

tools.name: get_district_profile
tools.description: Open-data profile of one London postcode district: HM Land Registry median sold prices of existing flats and houses (12 months, with sales counts and London figures) and five years of yearly medians, police.uk residential crime per 1,000 residents against London, Ofsted grades of its state schools with the Outstanding ones named, the share of its postcodes in Environment Agency flood zones 2 and 3, council tax bands and ONS official rents for its borough(s), and who lives there (Census 2021 tenure and age, and the share of residents in England's most deprived areas on the Index of Multiple Deprivation 2025). Each block has its window, definition, caveats and source, plus a sentence that keeps them together, and the district page URL to cite.

district.description: A London postcode district (outward code) such as "E17" or "SW11", or a full postcode such as "E17 4QH".

tools.name: get_commute_times
tools.description: Typical door-to-door public transport minutes (TfL Journey Planner, 09:00 weekday departure) from a London postcode district to London work hubs, quickest first, with the district's quickest sector. Hubs: canary-wharf (Canary Wharf), city-of-london (Bank / Liverpool Street / Moorgate), kings-cross (King's Cross), westminster (Westminster), oxford-circus (Oxford Circus), london-bridge (London Bridge), paddington (Paddington), stratford (Stratford), hammersmith (Hammersmith), victoria (Victoria), waterloo (Waterloo), farringdon (Farringdon).

district.description: A London postcode district (outward code) such as "E17" or "SW11", or a full postcode such as "E17 4QH".

hub.description: One hub only; leave out for all 12.

tools.name: rank_london_districts
tools.description: London postcode districts ranked on one open-data measure: lowest_crime_rate (police.uk residential crime per 1,000 residents), cheapest_houses (Land Registry median sold price of existing houses; flats are not ranked), most_outstanding_schools (Ofsted), or shortest_commute (needs hub). Optional borough filter, commute cut-off and reversed order (most expensive, highest crime, longest commute first). Ranks are London-wide.

hub.description: For shortest_commute: the work hub. canary-wharf (Canary Wharf), city-of-london (Bank / Liverpool Street / Moorgate), kings-cross (King's Cross), westminster (Westminster), oxford-circus (Oxford Circus), london-bridge (London Bridge), paddington (Paddington), stratford (Stratford), hammersmith (Hammersmith), victoria (Victoria), waterloo (Waterloo), farringdon (Farringdon).

borough.description: Only districts with postcodes in this London borough, e.g. "Lewisham".

max_minutes.description: For shortest_commute: only districts at or under this many minutes.

reverse.description: Worst first: highest crime, most expensive, fewest Outstanding schools, longest commute.

tools.name: compare_london_districts
tools.description: Side-by-side open-data figures for 2 to 6 London postcode districts and London as a whole: median sold price of existing houses, residential crime per 1,000 residents, Outstanding state schools, share of postcodes in flood zone 3, Band D council tax, the main borough's ONS official rent, the share of residents in England's most deprived 20% of areas, Census 2021 tenure, and optionally commute minutes to one hub.

items.description: A London postcode district (outward code) such as "E17" or "SW11", or a full postcode such as "E17 4QH".

districts.description: 2 to 6 outward codes or postcodes, e.g. ["E17", "E10", "N17"].

hub.description: Add typical commute minutes to this work hub.

bedrooms.description: Bedrooms for the official rent column: all (default), 1, 2, 3 or 4+.
